title: fallback diagnostics UX closeout
description: Resolve issues #668, #669, and #670 by making degraded rust-hybrid fallback diagnostics actionable across index/init, status, doctor, docs, and issue closeout.

decisions.q: 这轮是否包含 Vue/TypeScript 索引覆盖提升？
decisions.answer: 不把 Vue/TypeScript 解析能力提升作为本轮 P0；本轮关闭诊断透明度和工作流可解释性。
decisions.note: #670 的 Vue fallback reduction 可用文档和可测量后续项承接；否则本轮会从 UX 透明度扩张到语言覆盖迁移。

1-1.label: 界定 668 669 670 的剩余交付边界
1-1.notes: Remaining scope narrowed to degraded fallback diagnostic transparency. Vue/TypeScript parser coverage is out of this loop and should follow from measurable fallback reduction work.

1-2.label: 让 status 显示 last-run fallback 质量摘要
1-2.notes: Status now prints a Rust-hybrid Fallback section with fallback health, top translated reasons, per-file-diagnostics artifact hint, and exact doctor command; status --json exposes fallbackDiagnostics.

1-3.label: 让 doctor 输出原因翻译与 artifact 指向
1-3.notes: Doctor degraded summaries now name per-file-diagnostics.json as the privacy-preserving artifact and state the maintainer handoff next step.

1-4.label: 补充 global workflow 和 degraded guidance 文档
1-4.notes: README troubleshooting now clarifies init/index/sync/status/doctor workflow, degraded vs stale, and per-file diagnostic bundle privacy semantics.

1-5.label: 验证并关闭 issues 668 669 670
1-5.notes: Verification passed: fallback CLI tests, doctor bundle tests, status-json tests, npm run build, and git diff --check. Issues #668/#669/#670 should be closed after PR merge because their visible behavior depends on main.
